# NameClear

> Is your brand name available? NameClear checks domains, the live USPTO trademark register, and social handles in one pass.

NameClear inspects brand names for availability: .com/.co/.io/.net/.app domains via live registry RDAP endpoints, live USPTO federal trademark records (alive only), and X / Instagram / TikTok / YouTube handles. The instant check is free and unlimited; the full PDF write-up is a one-time $9 via Stripe Checkout.

Docs:
- [Home](https://nameclear.pages.dev/) — the checker
- [Pricing](https://nameclear.pages.dev/pricing) — free checks, $9 full report
- [About](https://nameclear.pages.dev/about) — what we check and how

Contact: contact@calyvent.com
